headline: You raced yesterday and I cannot see a second of it - the result is yours to tell me.
body:
Eight days since your watch last delivered anything to Garmin, and training.json is stamped **17 September 17:20** - **87 hours** old this morning. So I know the gun went at 07:00 into a **6.5 km/h** gust, and nothing after it.

Charge the watch and force a sync today; if it recorded the race at all, that file is worth recovering. Either way, send me four numbers - swim, bike, run, total - against plan.json's **5:40-6:20**.

No session today: the plan ends at the finish line. Walk **20-30 min**, flat, nothing that lifts your breathing. Keep eating at **3,000 kcal** for another two or three days. Cape Town gusts **35 km/h** and hits **28 C** midday - every window reads good for the bike, which it has not once in this file. Don't use it.

Then the ankle. **20 km** off the bike on a joint nobody has examined - how is it this morning? That answer sets the next fortnight.
